name: Chili Chicken Skewers with Ranch Cabbage, Apple & Cucumber Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels, cut into 1-inch cubes, and season with spices. Thread onto skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the chicken directly on the grill pan.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
2 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 Granny Smith apples
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and medium dice cucumbers. Place in a large bowl.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl along with shredded cabbage and dressing, then stir to combine the slaw.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
½ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide skewers and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
